📖 Type Guide
Classification rules for each trader type
🦁 Apex Predator
big_bet_rate > 60% · win_rate > 65% · durability > 50
🦅 Precision Hunter
win_rate > 72% · Sharpe* > 3 · PnL Draw < 25%
🧊 Ice Quant
Sharpe* > 5 · PnL Draw < 15% · durability > 50
🎯 Sniper
profit_factor > 3 · big_bet_count > 3 · win_rate < 55%
🎰 High Roller
PnL Draw > 40% · profit_factor > 1.5
📊 All-Rounder
win_rate > 60% · durability > 55
📈 Momentum
Sharpe* > 3 · total_pnl > 0
🎯 Steady Shot
win_rate > 65% · total_pnl > 0
💰 Value Hunter
profit_factor > 2 · total_pnl > 0
🎲 Bet Maker
big_bet_count > 20 · big_bet_rate > 50%
🌊 Degen
PnL Draw > 200% or (PnL Draw > 80% + big_bets > 10)
🌱 Newcomer
closed_count < 100
🌀 Drifter
fallback — no dominant pattern
